description: Find more prompts for a finished Discover run: start the next round of its series with the same sources, effort level, country, language and custom instructions. The round skips every question the series already suggested and reads evidence earlier rounds did not use, so its prompts add to the same list. Invoke only after the user asks for more prompts from an existing run, and confirm with them first: each round runs the same paid research as a new run. A series takes one round at a time and at most two after the first run, and ends early after a round that found fewer than ten new prompts or nothing new to read; the tool then refuses with the reason. Returns the new round's run ID; poll the discovery history tool with it. Prompts are not added to tracking automatically. Requires prompt-management permission and the series' source entitlements.

run_id.description: A finished Discover run, or any finished round of its series, to continue.

name: find_more_prompt_discovery
